name: unity
description: Observe, diagnose, and safely operate a Unity project's CLI build pipeline via the standalone Unity CLI. A read-first, gamedev-focused Claude Code agent with a project/Editor-version doctor that routes the CLI surface on Editor version (2022 LTS = batchmode; Unity 6 adds the verified Pipeline live-Editor surface and MCP), gated unity build/test/run, live-Editor control that honors Unity's own confirm/dry_run gates, license-vs-auth diagnosis, and a project-tree guard hook.
